title: Voi, signor, che giusto siete
subtitle: Finale of Act 2 (No. 15), section 5: Marcellina, Bartolo and Basilio arrive

facts.tempo: Allegro assai at ♩ = 132, then Più Allegro at ♩ = 152 and Prestissimo at ♩ = 176 (about 5 minutes)

note: Marcellina, Bartolo and Basilio arrive to claim Figaro's promise of marriage
about: Score: the fifth and last section of the Act 2 Finale, No. 15, from the entrance of Marcellina, Bartolo and Basilio “Voi, signor, che giusto siete” to the end of the act (vocal score pages 186-204, 243 bars), from Paul Klengel's piano reduction in the Breitkopf & Härtel vocal score (Edition Breitkopf 1716, about 1900), public domain.
